coreAndMapRegression: Passed in the combined integration run; outdated GPS fixtures were corrected and affected suites rerun separately.
scope: Integration databases were disposable localhost replica sets. GPS travel was simulated only locally. Browser decoding/playback is verified, not human audible-device playback or a physical journey.
limitations: Browser GPS reports are not independent proof of physical travel.
Physical mobile-device sound and closed-browser delivery were not verified.
Pre-upgrade in-progress trips without recorded start/progress evidence require the controlled early-end review.
Early-ending charges default to zero. Positive reviewed charges require the saved verified-service policy, observed post-start travel, rider confirmation and explicit administrator settlement.
